name: Pizza Casserole
description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Dad's Spaghetti
_similar.description: A comforting spaghetti dish with bacon, mushrooms, and a creamy mushroom soup sauce.
recipeIngredient: 1 to 2 tsp garlic salt or 1 to 2 minced garlic cloves

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti, drain, and set aside.
Brown bacon in a frying pan with garlic salt or minced garlic.
Remove bacon and most of the grease from the pan.
Cook onion and mushrooms in the same pan until tender.
Return bacon to the pan and add mushroom soup.
Stir and heat the sauce through, adding cheese and enough water to achieve the desired consistency.
Combine the sauce with cooked spaghetti and serve.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti, bacon, mushroom sauce, creamy pasta

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti sauce made with ground hamburger, vegetables, and a blend of herbs and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the onion, celery, and garlic until tender.
Add the ground hamburger and brown.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for several hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade sauce, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Mozzarella Spaghetti Skillet
_similar.description: A one-pot spaghetti dish cooked with hamburger, tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: Broken spaghetti to feed your family

recipeInstructions.text: In an electric skillet, brown the hamburger, onion, and green peppers.
Season with Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, water, and broken spaghetti to the skillet.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring frequently to prevent the spaghetti from sticking.
Simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Shortly before serving, add shredded mozzarella cheese and continue heating until melted.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti skillet, one-pot pasta, mozzarella cheese
